question: Can ordinary action-based agency apply to an all-pervading self without vibration?
premises: Ordinary agency is established through connection with action.
Such ordinary agency involves vibration or movement.
The all-pervading self is described as devoid of vibration.
inference: Therefore, ordinary action-based agency does not fit an all-pervading, vibrationless self.
plain_english: Can the kind of agency known from ordinary action, which involves vibration, really belong to an all-pervading self that has no vibration?
